from fractions import Fraction as F

# Model: train length L, pole passing time t, platform length P.
# Pole: v = L / t.  Platform: v = (L + P) / (6t).
# Given P = 5L, test whether the platform condition holds for each candidate L.

t = F(1)  # fixed positive time; the ratio argument does not depend on its value
t_check = F(7, 3)  # second independent time value, to confirm t cancels

def platform_consistent(L, t_val):
    v_pole = L / t_val
    P = 5 * L
    v_platform = (L + P) / (6 * t_val)
    return v_pole == v_platform

candidates = [F(n, 4) for n in range(1, 81)]  # exact rationals 1/4 .. 20
consistent_t1 = [L for L in candidates if platform_consistent(L, t)]
consistent_t2 = [L for L in candidates if platform_consistent(L, t_check)]
